notes: City of Valley, FYE 9/30/2022. Governmental funds cash basis (p3-4, Total column); proprietary funds accrual (p5-7, Total column: Proprietary + Nursing Home), business_type measure net position as FY2023. Governmental receipts/disbursements from p4 Total column (taxes printed by type). Printed-section rule: Grants and donations 2,385,560, Bond fees, Debt service principal/interest and Tax increment financing are printed under Other Financing Sources (Uses) on p4 and go to other_financing (-640,419); transfers in 23,041 / out 509,127 (Bond Fund). Ending fund balance 9,826,201 as printed on p4 (p3 shows 9,826,200). ending_cash = Cash 6,661,360 (p3); cash with county treasurer 90,526 separate (as FY2023). Beginning cash not printed. Business-type receipts total computed (operating revenues + interest income); disbursements = Statement of Activities total business-type expenses p2. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position p1 by Governmental / Business-type column (same lines as governmental funds statement p3); debt not split by due date on p1. Detail: General Fund from the combining schedule pp10-11 by department column (Cemetery spending is counted in Public safety on p4, so its function is public safety); the governmental budget schedule p8 combines all governmental funds including the General Fund and is not recorded (would double count; it cannot be separated by fund), so Bond, Sales Tax, Keno and TIF funds are taken from their p4 statement columns; business-type detail from the proprietary budget schedule p9 (budgetary basis), as FY2023. Report has many $1 rounding differences (report_discrepancies). Read pages 1-11 of 11
